findings: Verified14 task files and60 shared files against pinned Git identities, plus all9 files in the complete pinned HF task listing.8 assets are in the release manifest; the ninth is additional metadata. The13MB paper PDF is inventoried but not needed or fetched.

Raw data has42 fields:10 times from0 to7.2 hours and28 complex visibilities/noise estimates/baseline coordinates/station pairs per frame. The8-hour window is not10 integrations covering continuous time; metadata uses0.8-hour steps. All8-station pairs are included; source is synthetic, not observed Sgr A* data.

The pure32x32 crescent fixture and all10 supplied reference images agree with their fixed declared array formula. Diameter is twice the Gaussian ring center radius, width is Gaussian sigma, asymmetry controls a cosine brightness modulation, and angle follows atan2(grid_y,grid_x). README outer-diameter and E-of-N wording does not establish independent celestial calibration.

Source preprocessing constructs56 triangle phases and70 log-amplitude ratios from28 visibilities. Their coefficient matrices have ranks21 and19. Adding the other four-station ratio raises amplitude rank to20. Thus the count126 is not an independent-measurement count. Fixed station gain transformations preserve wrapped phases and log ratios to numerical precision; no new observations were simulated.

The only released numerical fixture tests a fixed crescent image. It does not test flow training, NUFFT, closure losses, importance reweighting or uncertainty calibration. The source parses, but full runtime recovery is not verified.

Saved arrays contain10x10000x4 float32 physical parameter samples,10x10000 weights and10x64x64 mean images. The source constructs a fresh flow for every frame, with no temporal coupling. Historical notebook outputs load these saved arrays and are not training logs.

All40 weighted means/stds/biases and aggregate reports reproduce within two float32 steps per original summary. Largest mean difference is1.52587890625e-5 degrees. Retained angle MAE is6.076638963 degrees; native recipe replay gives6.076640871. Original reports remain unchanged.

Effective sample sizes span4.336 to110.875 of10000. The largest single normalized weight is45.92 percent in frame9. Frame4 has -26.2394 degree angle bias. This is evidence of weight concentration and a local discrepancy, not a calibrated uncertainty or population failure rate.

Supplemental weighted inverse-CDF intervals at0.16 and0.84 contain truth in6/10 diameter,10/10 width,9/10 asymmetry and8/10 angle snapshots. These snapshots share one synthetic sequence; descriptive containment is not a calibration study or independent repeated-trial coverage estimate.

A point distribution collapsed on each supplied truth has zero parameter bias and zero spread, demonstrating that point error cannot certify distribution quality. This is an oracle counterexample with answer access. A separate fixed[-179,179] angle example produces source linear mean0 and bias-180 versus circular mean180; actual saved angles do not cross the seam, so this does not explain their errors.

Pinned scalar source assignments weight likelihood70 times more in the full training objective than in importance reweighting, relative to the same log-density term. This mismatch is reproduced with fixed losses only. No checkpoint, latent samples or log-density arrays are released to establish corrected weights or corrected outcomes.

Both supplied truth and retained mean images sum to approximately1; the generator scales its visibility input by0.6 Jy. A fixed reference-array DFT yields residual RMS/sigma0.768..1.166 at0.6 scaling and11.52..14.52 atunit scaling. This verifies the stored normalization distinction, not NUFFT equivalence or a calibrated chi-squared test. Scorer needs the unit-flux reference convention despite README Jy/pixel text.

Live local dispatch uses generic reconstruction scoring. Saved images give cosine NCC0.996218 and global range-NRMSE0.022811 with no pass boundaries. Native posterior and10x4 mean arrays are rejected. The historical task-aware recipe instead reports angle MAE; it is not the live generic dispatch.

Generic shape-based reference selection chooses asymmetry for any10-element vector. Even exact constant asymmetry returns infinite range-NRMSE because its reference range is zero. A source-angle vector is compared against asymmetry. These fixed oracle controls expose scorer limitations, not admissible submitted solutions.

The no-filesystem generic fallback searches only ground_truth.npy, which this release lacks, and exits with a missing-reference error before any runner execution. No Docker or runtime equivalence is claimed.

All L1-L3 seed the entire data directory including ground_truth.npz and the extra answer-bearing meta_data file. The normal loader reads meta_data.json without those explicit parameters, but the additional file is still solver-visible. Installer commands were intercepted; no environment was created. src and evaluation were absent from staged workspaces.

The design card still describes UVFITS/ehtim inputs, but the pinned executable loader readsNPZ and the complete released asset listing has noUVFITS.
